About Intellect AI

TL;DR
  • Intellect AI is a free guide to AI coaching, reading habits and learning with AI.
  • It is made by the team behind Zehn, a book-summary app by Safari Group.
  • No accounts, no ads, no tracking cookies.

What is Intellect AI?

Intellect AI is a free website with guides, copy-ready prompts and example conversations for nine AI coaches, plus practical guides on reading, book clubs and learning with AI. Everything on the site is free to read and use, and the prompts work in any AI chat.

Who makes it?

Intellect AI is made by the team behind Zehn, a book-summary app with 10,000+ books, Ask AI on every book and an AI Chat with nine coaching personas. Both are projects of Safari Group, a company founded in Dubai in 2005. The founder is Muhammad Safarzoda.

How we write

We write original guides for people, not search engines. We only state facts we can stand behind, label example conversations as examples, and say clearly where AI is not a substitute for a professional: health, mental health, law and large money decisions. When we mention Zehn, we say so.

Contact

Questions, corrections or ideas for a guide: contact@safarigrp.com.
